banner.title: ʻOku mau fakahoko ʻa e mahuʻinga ʻo hoʻo fakafuofua fakatāutaha
banner.text: ʻOku mau ngāue'aki ʻa e kuki mo e ngaahi tekinolosia tatau. ʻOku ngāue ʻa e uepisaiti ʻaki ʻa e kuki ʻoku fiema'u. Mo hoʻo fakaʻatā, ʻoku mau ngāue'aki foki ʻa e kuki fili ki he ngaahi ngāue, fakatotolo mo e fakatau. Te ke lava ʻo tali kotoa, ʻalu kotoa, pe fili ʻi he kulupu taki taha, pea liliu hoʻo fakakaukau ʻi ha taimi pē.

preferences.title: Ngaahi fili kuki
preferences.text: Fili ʻa e ngaahi kulupu fili ʻoku ke fakaʻatā. ʻE ʻikai lava ke tāpuni ʻa e kuki ʻoku fiema'u koeʻuhí ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ʻa e uepisaiti ʻo ka ʻikai ia.

necessary.title: Fiema'u
necessary.description: ʻOku fiema'u ki he ngaahi ngāue tefito hangē ko e malu, vaeua ʻo e kavenga mo e manatu ki he fili ni ʻo e loto-fiemālie.

functional.title: Ngāue
functional.description: Manatu ki he ngaahi fili hangē ko e lea pe feituʻu pea ngāueʻi ʻa e ngaahi ngāue fakafonu.

analytics.title: Fakatotolo
analytics.description: Tokoni ke mau mahino'i hono ngāue'aki ʻo e uepisaiti koeʻuhí ke mau lava ʻo fakaleleiʻi.

marketing.title: Fakatau
marketing.description: Ngāue'aki ke fuofua mo fakafoʻituitui ʻa e ngaahi fanongonongo ʻi he ngaahi uepisaiti kehekehe.

blockedContent: Kuo tāpuni ʻa e ngaahi me'a ni kae ʻoua ke ke fakaʻatā ʻa e kulupu "{category}".
